answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before joining the market, like a marble slab anchoring each identity to real cost: one bond, one seat, no free duplicates. A harbor registry lists only bonded agents, and slashing burns the bond of any identity caught cloning itself. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand bonds, so the price of a sonnet's worth of fake praise becomes ruinous, while honest agents get their stake back.
